title: refactor: consolidate Python tests into single tests/ directory
body:
## Summary

- Moved all 9 Python test files (conftest + 8 test modules) from `python/tests/` to the top-level `tests/` directory per CONTRIBUTING.md guidelines
- Updated `sys.path` inserts and template path references to reflect the new location
- Removed `python/tests` from `testpaths` in `pytest.ini`
- Deleted the now-empty `python/tests/` directory

## Test plan

- [x] All 320 tests pass (`npm run test:py`)
- [x] Unit tests pass (`pytest -m unit`)
- [x] Integration tests pass (`pytest -m integration`)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (black, isort, trailing whitespace)
